description: Welcome to our team! We are exploring the stories behind NASA’s abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars. Through creativity, research, storytelling, and multimedia, we aim to uncover the history of these forgotten explorers and share their significance with the world. We welcome curious minds, fresh ideas, and a passion for space. Let’s work together remotely to create something meaningful, informative, and unforgettable!
summary: Abandoned but Not Forgotten is a digital storytelling and scientific research project that explores the spacecraft, robotic explorers, scientific instruments, and mission equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Through ten storytelling chapters, historical photographs, mission timelines, and scientific artifact records, it uncovers the stories behind humanity's journey beyond Earth. The project examines historic missions such as Apollo 11, Viking 1, Mars Pathfinder, Spirit, Opportunity, Phoenix, and InSight, highlighting their purposes, discoveries, and lasting contributions. It also explores how extreme environments affect space hardware and why preserving extraterrestrial heritage matters. By combining verified NASA information with creative storytelling, this exhibition aims to make space science engaging and accessible. Ultimately, it reminds visitors that even when machines become silent, their discoveries continue to shape our understanding of the universe and inspire future generations of explorers.
details: Abandoned but Not Forgotten is a digital storytelling and scientific research project exploring the legacy of human and robotic exploration on the Moon and Mars. It focuses on two historic missions: Apollo 11, humanity's first crewed Moon landing, and Viking 1, the first successful U.S. landing mission on Mars. Through historical photographs, scientific artifact records, mission details, and creative storytelling, the project examines the equipment these missions left behind and the purposes they served. It highlights their contributions to space exploration, the discoveries they made possible, and their importance in preserving humanity's scientific heritage beyond Earth. The project also encourages visitors to distinguish verified scientific facts from creative interpretations while understanding why these historic sites deserve recognition and respect. By combining science, history, and storytelling, Abandoned but Not Forgotten aims to inspire curiosity about the universe and remind visitors that even when missions end, their achievements continue to shape our understanding of other worlds.
